lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide / a first guide for a new fiscal year is a scheduled guidance event': the release carries the first FY27 statement against a £15.3m PBT consensus, so abs_move_pct went up from 4.0 to 4.5 (roughly 0.7 x 3% + 0.3 x 9%, plus the <=2-analyst coverage band); the sign stays unknown.
'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': confirmed not filing any FY26 reported-quarter finding, since the 24 Jun update pre-released profit as in line.
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide': added 31 May net debt as an explicit new_in_release line with the FY25 precedent (-4.08% on net debt); no sourced lead, so it adds no signed finding.
'A truncated zero is not a disclosure': positioning_check states there is no anchor rather than 'nobody is short'.
